q: Consider the statements: (i) The mean and variance of a Poisson random variable are equal; (ii) For a standard normal random variable, the mean is zero and the variance is one. Which ONE of the following options is correct?

[NAT] Let X be a random variable exponentially distributed with parameter λ > 0, with pdf f_X(x) = λe^(-λx) for x ≥ 0 and 0 otherwise. If 5E(X) = Var(X), where E(X) and Var(X) indicate the expectation and variance of X, the value of λ is ______ (rounded off to one decimal place).
The cumulative distribution function of a random variable X is F_X(x) = 0 for x ≤ -1, (x+1)^2/4 for -1 ≤ x ≤ 1, and 1 for x ≥ 1. The value of P(X^2 ≤ 0.25) is: (A) 0.625 (B) 0.25 (C) 0.5 (D) 0.5625.

Let Y = ⌊X⌋ (floor), where X is an exponentially distributed random variable with mean 1/ln 10. For any positive integer ℓ, the probability of the event Y = ℓ can be written as P(Y = ℓ) = q^ℓ(1 - q). The value of q is: (A) 0.1 (B) 0.01 (C) 0.5 (D) 0.434.

[MSQ] Let X be a discrete valued random variable with cumulative distribution function F(x). Which of the following statements is/are correct? (A) F(x) is always a positive function (B) F(x) is a non-decreasing function (C) F(x) has jump discontinuity (D) F(x) is a left continuous function.

[NAT] X is a random variable uniformly distributed in the interval [1, 3] and Y is a random variable uniformly distributed in the interval [2, 4]; X and Y are independent of each other. The probability P(X ≥ Y) is ______ (rounded off to three decimal places).
[NAT] Consider two events T and S, where T̄ denotes the complement of event T. Given P(T̄) = 0.6, P(S|T) = 0.3 and P(S|T̄) = 0.6, the value of P(T|S) is ______ (rounded off to two decimal places).

[NAT] A Bayesian network consists of four Bernoulli random variables with structure U → V, U → W, V → Z, W → Z and CPTs: P(U=1) = 0.5; P(V=1|U=0) = P(V=1|U=1) = 0.5; P(W=1|U=0) = 0 and P(W=1|U=1) = 1; P(Z=1|V=0,W=0) = 0.5, P(Z=1|V=0,W=1) = 0, P(Z=1|V=1,W=0) = 0, P(Z=1|V=1,W=1) = 0.5. The value of P(U=1, V=1, W=1, Z=1) is ______ (rounded off to three decimal places).

[NAT] Box-1 (containing 2 black and 1 white ball) is selected with probability 1/2, Box-2 (1 black, 2 white) with probability 1/6, and Box-3 (3 black, 3 white) with probability 1/3; a ball is then drawn at random from the selected box. Given that the ball drawn is white, the probability that it was drawn from Box-2 is ______ (rounded off to two decimal places).

[NAT] In a clinic, a person suffering from disease D tests positive 80% of the time, a person not suffering from D tests positive 10% of the time, and 30% of the general population suffers from D. If a person tests positive for D at that clinic, the probability that he/she actually suffers from the disease is ______ (rounded off to two decimal places).
[NAT] The joint probability density function of two random variables X and Y is f_X,Y(x, y) = 2xy for 0 < x < 2 and 0 < y < x (0 otherwise). Then E[Y | X = 1.5] is ______.

[NAT] Two fair coins are tossed independently. X is a random variable that takes the value 1 if both tosses are heads and 0 otherwise; Y takes the value 1 if at least one of the tosses is heads and 0 otherwise. The value of the covariance of X and Y is ______ (rounded off to three decimal places).
The conditional expectation of X given Y is denoted by E[X|Y]. Then E[E[X|Y]] equals: (A) E[X|Y] (B) E[X]E[Y] (C) E[X] (D) E[Y].

Let X = aZ + b, where Z is a standard normal random variable and a, b are two unknown constants. It is given that E[X] = 1, E[(X - E[X])Z] = -2 and E[(X - E[X])^2] = 4. The values of a, b are: (A) a = -2, b = 1 (B) a = 2, b = -1 (C) a = -2, b = -1 (D) a = 1, b = 1.
[NAT] X follows Uniform(-1, 1) and the conditional distribution of Y given X = x is Uniform(x^2 - 0.1, x^2 + 0.1). The value of correlation(X, Y) is ______ (answer in integer).

Let Y = Σ_{i=1}^{300} X_i, where X_i ~ Bernoulli(θ) are independent and identically distributed with θ = 0.25. The value of P(60 ≤ Y ≤ 90), after approximation through the Central Limit Theorem, is given by (φ denotes the standard normal CDF): (A) φ(2) - φ(-2) (B) φ(1) - φ(-1) (C) φ(3) - φ(-3) (D) φ(90) - φ(60).

[MSQ] Z follows Normal(μ = 0, σ^2 = 1) with probability density function g(z) and CDF G(z); Y follows t_1 distribution with pdf h(y) and CDF H(y). Let c be the positive real number for which g(c) = h(c). Which of the following statements is/are correct? (A) G(0) = H(0) (B) G(c) < H(c) (C) G(-c) < H(-c) (D) g(0) = h(0).

[MSQ] X1, X2, ..., Xn are n independent Normal(μ = 0, σ^2 = 1) random variables and X̄ = (1/n) Σ_{i=1}^{n} X_i. Which of the following statements is/are correct? (A) Σ X_i^2 follows Chi-square distribution with n degrees of freedom (B) Σ (X_i - X̄)^2 follows Chi-square distribution with (n-1) degrees of freedom (C) X1^2 + Xn^2 follows exponential distribution with mean 2 (D) (√n · X̄)^2 follows Chi-square distribution with 2 degrees of freedom.

topic: Vector Spaces, Subspaces, Linear Dependence and Independence
q: [MSQ] Select all choices that are subspaces of R^3: (A) {x = α[1,1,0]^T + β[1,0,0]^T : α, β ∈ R} (B) {x = α^2[1,2,0]^T + β^2[1,0,1]^T : α, β ∈ R} (C) {x ∈ R^3 : 5x1 + 2x3 = 0, 4x1 - 2x2 + 3x3 = 0} (D) {x ∈ R^3 : 5x1 + 2x3 + 4 = 0}.

topic: Vector Spaces, Subspaces, Linear Dependence and Independence
q: [MSQ] Which of the following statements is/are correct? (A) R^n has a unique set of orthonormal basis vectors (B) R^n does not have a unique set of orthonormal basis vectors (C) Linearly independent vectors in R^n are orthonormal (D) Orthonormal vectors in R^n are linearly independent.

topic: Vector Spaces, Subspaces, Linear Dependence and Independence
q: Let {x1, x2, ..., xn} be a set of linearly independent vectors in R^n, and let the (i, j)-th element of the matrix A ∈ R^{n×n} be given by A_ij = x_i^T x_j for 1 ≤ i, j ≤ n. Which one of the following statements is correct? (A) A is invertible (B) 0 is a singular value of A (C) Determinant of A is 0 (D) z^T A z = 0 for some non-zero z ∈ R^n.

topic: Vector Spaces, Subspaces, Linear Dependence and Independence
q: Consider the set S1 = {x = (x1, x2, x3)^T ∈ R^3 : x^T x ≤ 16}. Let S2 be another set which is a subspace of R^3 with dimension two. Which of the following gives the area of S1 ∩ S2? (A) 16π (B) 4π (C) 4π^2 (D) 16π^2.

Consider the matrix M = [[2, -1], [3, 1]]. Which ONE of the following statements is TRUE? (A) The eigenvalues of M are non-negative and real (B) The eigenvalues of M are complex conjugate pairs (C) One eigenvalue of M is positive and real, and another eigenvalue of M is zero (D) One eigenvalue of M is non-negative and real, and another eigenvalue of M is negative and real.
[NAT] Consider the 3 × 3 matrix M = [[1,2,3],[3,1,3],[4,3,6]]. The determinant of (M^2 + 12M) is ______.

Let A ∈ R^{n×n} be such that A^3 = A. Which one of the following statements is ALWAYS correct? (A) A is invertible (B) Determinant of A is 0 (C) The sum of the diagonal elements of A is 1 (D) A and A^2 have the same rank.

Let γ1, γ2, γ3 be the eigenvalues of the matrix [[1,0,0],[0,cos t, sin t],[0,-sin t, cos t]], where t ∈ [-π, π] is in radians. Which one of the following options lists all the possible values of t satisfying γ1 + γ2 + γ3 = 1 + √2? (A) {π/3, -π/4} (B) {π/4, -π/3} (C) {π/4, -π/4} (D) {π/3, -π/3}.

[NAT] Let A = I_n - (1/n)11^T, where 1 = (1, 1, ..., 1)^T ∈ R^n and I_n is the identity matrix of order n. The value of max over S of x^T A x, where S = {x ∈ R^n : x^T x = 1}, is ______ (answer in integer).

[MSQ] Let U be a subspace of R^3 and M ∈ R^{3×3} be the matrix corresponding to the projection onto the subspace U. Which of the following statements is/are TRUE? (A) If U is a 1-dimensional subspace of R^3, then the null space of M is a 1-dimensional subspace (B) If U is a 2-dimensional subspace of R^3, then the null space of M is a 1-dimensional subspace (C) M^2 = M (D) M^3 = M.
[NAT] Let u = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]^T, and let σ1, σ2, σ3, σ4, σ5 be the singular values of the matrix M = u u^T (where u^T is the transpose of u). The value of Σ_{i=1}^{5} σ_i is ______.

[MSQ] Let x1, x2, x3, x4, x5 be a system of orthonormal vectors in R^10, and consider the matrix A = x1x1^T + x2x2^T + x3x3^T + x4x4^T + x5x5^T. Which of the following statements is/are correct? (A) Singular values of A are also its eigenvalues (B) Singular values of A are either 0 or 1 (C) Determinant of A is 1 (D) A is invertible.

[MSQ] Let M = I_n - (1/n)11^T, where 1 = (1, 1, ..., 1)^T ∈ R^n and I_n is the identity matrix of order n. Which of the following options is/are correct? (A) M^T = M (B) M^2 = I_n (C) Trace(M) = n (D) M is a projection matrix.

topic: Functions of a Single Variable — Limits, Continuity, Differentiability
q: Let f: R → R be the function f(x) = -x if x < -2, ax^2 + bx + c if x ∈ [-2, 2], and x if x > 2. Which ONE of the following choices of a, b, c makes the function f continuous and differentiable? (A) a = 1/4, b = 0, c = 1 (B) a = 1/2, b = 0, c = 0 (C) a = 0, b = 0, c = 0 (D) a = 1, b = 1, c = -4.

topic: Functions of a Single Variable — Limits, Continuity, Differentiability
q: [NAT] Evaluate the following limit: lim_{x→0} ln((x^2 + 1) cos x) / x^2 = ______.

topic: Functions of a Single Variable — Limits, Continuity, Differentiability
q: [MSQ] Consider two functions f: R → R and g: R → (1, ∞), both differentiable at a point c. Which of the following functions is/are ALWAYS differentiable at c? (A) f ± g (B) f · g (C) f/g (D) f ∘ g + g ∘ f.

topic: Functions of a Single Variable — Limits, Continuity, Differentiability
q: [NAT] Evaluate: lim_{t→+∞} (√(t^2 + t) - t) = ______ (rounded off to one decimal place).

topic: Functions of a Single Variable — Limits, Continuity, Differentiability
q: [NAT] Let f: R → R be such that |f(x) - f(y)| ≤ (x - y)^2 for all x, y ∈ R. Then f(1) - f(0) = ______ (answer in integer).
Let f(x) = (e^x - e^(-x))/2 for x ∈ R, and let f^(k)(a) denote the kth derivative of f evaluated at a. What is the value of f^(10)(0)? (A) 0 (B) 1 (C) 1/10! (D) 2/10!.

topic: Maxima, Minima and Optimisation of Single-Variable Functions
q: For any twice differentiable function f: R → R, if at some x* ∈ R, f'(x*) = 0 and f''(x*) > 0, then the function f necessarily has a ______ at x = x*. (A) local minimum (B) global minimum (C) local maximum (D) global maximum.

topic: Maxima, Minima and Optimisation of Single-Variable Functions
q: [MSQ] Consider the function f: R → R defined by f(x) = x^4/4 - 2x^3/3 - 3x^2/2 + 1. Which of the following statements is/are TRUE? (A) x = 0 is a local maximum of f (B) x = 3 is a local minimum of f (C) x = -1 is a local maximum of f (D) x = 0 is a local minimum of f.

topic: Maxima, Minima and Optimisation of Single-Variable Functions
q: [MSQ] Consider the function f(x) = x^3/3 + (7/2)x^2 + 10x + 133/2 on the interval [-8, 0]. Which of the following statements is/are correct? (A) The maximum value of f is attained at x = -5 (B) The minimum value of f is attained at x = -2 (C) The maximum value of f is 133/2 (D) The minimum value of the derivative of f is attained at x = -7/2.

topic: Maxima, Minima and Optimisation of Single-Variable Functions
q: [MSQ] Let f: R → R be a twice-differentiable function and suppose its second derivative satisfies f''(x) > 0 for all x ∈ R. Which of the following statements is/are ALWAYS correct? (A) f has a local minima (B) There does not exist x and y, x ≠ y, such that f'(x) = f'(y) = 0 (C) f has at most one global minimum (D) f has at most one local minimum.

topic: Maxima, Minima and Optimisation of Single-Variable Functions
q: [MSQ] Let f(x) = x^3 - 3x^2 + 2 be a function defined on (-1, 3]. Which of the following statements is/are correct? (A) f(x) has exactly two roots in [-0.9, 0] (B) f(x) has a minimum at 2 only (C) f(x) has maximum at 0 only (D) f(x) has a root at 1.
